_about: DOC-011 answer key with table values (IS 1460:2017 Table 1 as hosted by IOCL). Values read from the scan and the Qwen3-VL OCR transcription; status PROPOSED (agent-read), pending a human spot-check. Method-of-Test values are deliberately excluded: the OCR row-shifts that column in rows vi-ix and xv-xvii (unresolved).
